name: ai-share-market-analysis-tool
description: AI-powered analysis tool for the Indian share market (Equity, Stock/Index Futures, Stock/Index Options, Nifty, Bank Nifty, Fin Nifty). Phase 1 foundation monorepo.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && echo "\nNOTE: ai-engine is Python. Run: cd ai-engine && pip install -r requirements.txt"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
